how-24-01-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the manatee, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-24-01-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the manatee, then tap three things you notice.

how-24-01-compare.page: Put the water under one tray and the fan under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.
how-24-01-compare.say: Put the water under one tray and the fan under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.

how-24-01-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.
how-24-01-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.

how-24-01-det.page: Pick 3 cases, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick the problem. Predict the solution that helped, and watch the place today appear.
how-24-01-det.say: Pick three cases, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick the problem. Predict the solution that helped, and watch the place today appear.

how-24-01-write.page: Think of a natural place near you. Answer the three questions. Use at least two of the science words under the boxes.
how-24-01-write.say: Think of a natural place near you. Answer the three questions. Use at least two of the science words under the boxes.

how-24-01-partc.page: Draw one habitat twice: damaged on the left, and helped by conservation on the right. Label what changed.
how-24-01-partc.say: Draw one habitat twice: damaged on the left, and helped by conservation on the right. Label what changed.
